catalog.name: FormWav
catalog.summary: Audio editing: record, edit, repair, mix and export.

notes_for_owner: Windows signing comes from formcompiler: it merges bundle.windows.signCommand into src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json (keeping its resources) or passes the certificate through its --config file; build_windows_app.ps1 has no signing hook of its own. Every build script passes FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG to tauri build. The macOS app carries its helpers' Homebrew libraries in Contents/Frameworks (src-tauri/gather_macos_libs) and is signed with src-tauri/entitlements.plist; setup.macos still needs brew install pkgconf libsndfile portaudio lilv at build time.
